description: Defines the AnalyticsService class for logging analytics events, with a local persistence mechanism using shared preferences, intended for future integration with backend analytics services.

classes.name: AnalyticsService
classes.description: A lightweight service class for logging analytics events, currently implemented with local storage and a debug print fallback.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs an event with a given name and optional parameters, increments a counter in shared preferences, and outputs to console in debug mode.
